manifest.name: dsh-ark-quota
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a sidebar panel showing Volcengine Ark (火山方舟) Agent Plan / Coding Plan remaining quota, reset countdowns and a monthly usage heatmap.
manifest.author: nnautilus

scripts.test: node test/sign.test.mjs && node test/integration.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# dsh-ark-quota：把「火山方舟额度」面板挂进 DSH Web 的左侧栏。
# 面板本体由浏览器端 client.js 渲染，Host 端 index.js 负责签名并请求
# 火山引擎控制面 OpenAPI（GetAFPUsage / GetCodingPlanUsage）。
- insert:
    - id: ark-quota
      name: dsh-ark-quota
      config:
        region: cn-beijing
        refreshSeconds: 60

readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把「火山方舟额度」面板挂进 Web 界面左侧栏，实时显示 **Agent Plan / Coding Plan 剩余额度**与用量统计。

要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（Web / 桌面端均可）。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nnautilus/dsh-ark-quota

readme.section: 或者克隆后以本地目录安装
readme.text:
git clone https://github.com/nnautilus/dsh-ark-quota
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-ark-quota
```

> 桌面端没有可用的 `dsh plugin` 入口时，也可以在 DSH 会话里直接说「把 https://github.com/nnautilus/dsh-ark-quota 装到当前 profile」，由 Harness 自己完成安装。

安装后左侧栏会出现一个柱状图标，点开即是额度面板。首次使用需要填一次 AccessKey（见下文「配置」）。

- **5 小时窗口 / 本周 / 本月** 三个额度窗口：剩余 AFP、已用 / 总额、已用百分比、重置倒计时
- **用量统计**：套餐档位、账号（AK 掩码）、消耗速度（%/小时）、按当前速度预计耗尽时间
- **本月每日用量热力图**（Codex 式小方格）：左侧是当月日历格（周一为周始，颜色深浅表示当天用量，悬停显示当天数值），右侧摘要卡显示本月合计 / 今日 / 日均 / 活跃天数 / 单日最高 / 主要模型
- **Coding Plan**（仅当确实订阅时）：会话 / 周 / 月窗口的百分比与重置时间；未订阅则整块不出现（不显示「未订阅」占位）
- 每 60 秒自动刷新（可在插件配置里改），也支持手动刷新

额度来自火山引擎**控制面 OpenAPI**，与推理接口不是同一条链路：

```
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetAFPUsage&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetCodingPlanUsage&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetUsageDetails&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
     body: { "QueryInterval": "Day", "Filter": { "Product": "agent-plan", "StartTime": "2026-10-01", "EndTime": "2026-10-27" } }

`GetUsageDetails` 返回按天的 `Details[]`（`Time` / `ObjectName` / `Usage` / `Unit` / `BillingType`），
热力图就是它的投影；body 参与签名，Host 端按 JSON 请求体计算 `X-Content-Sha256`。

鉴权是火山引擎签名 V4（AccessKey ID + Secret）。**方舟的推理 API Key（ARK_API_KEY）不能用于这里**，网关会以 `InvalidAuthorization` 拒绝。签名只在 Host 端完成，密钥不进浏览器。
火山引擎控制台 → 右上角头像 → 「API 访问密钥」→ 新建 AccessKey，并确保该账号有方舟用量查询权限。

打开左侧栏的「火山方舟额度」，首次会显示配置表单，填入 AccessKey ID / Secret 保存即可（写入 DSH 凭据库，引用名默认 `VOLC_ACCESSKEY` / `VOLC_SECRETKEY`）。

也可以自行往 DSH 凭据库写入同名凭据，或设置同名环境变量。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessKeyRef` | `VOLC_ACCESSKEY` | AccessKey ID 的凭据引用名 |
| `secretKeyRef` | `VOLC_SECRETKEY` | AccessKey Secret 的凭据引用名 |
| `region` | `cn-beijing` | 控制面区域 |
| `refreshSeconds` | `60` | 缓存时长 / 自动刷新周期（秒，最小 15） |
| `includeCodingPlan` | `true` | 是否同时查 Coding Plan |
| `historySize` | `72` | 内存采样点上限（用于消耗速度/预计耗尽） |

面板不通过插件自有 RPC 通道取数：desktop 端对裸 `connection.rpc` 通道不可达，
客户端会退化成 HTTP 请求并拿到 405。因此改用**同源 HTTP 路由**：

```
GET /dsh-ark-quota/status[?force=1]  →  { ok: true, value: {...} }
```

路由由 `ctx.webServer.register` 注册，并用 `connection.requestRejection` 做信任栅栏
（不可用时退回「同源 + 回环」校验，fail-closed）。未认证请求返回 401，
非 GET 返回 405，未注册路径 404——可据此判断路由是否已生效。

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host：火山签名 V4、OpenAPI 请求、响应归一化、缓存与历史、`/dsh-ark-quota/status` 路由 |
| `client.js` | Client：侧栏图标、主面板（额度卡片 / 统计 / 月度用量热力图 / AK-SK 表单） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch，插入 `ark-quota` 插件行 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件列表里的标题与描述 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |

```bash
node test/sign.test.mjs         # 签名 + 响应解析（期望值与 Python 独立复刻比对）
node test/integration.test.mjs  # 用桩 Host 驱动 apply()，并以假 AK/SK 真实请求 OpenAPI
node test/client.test.mjs       # 桩 React 渲染各分支
node test/live-optional.mjs     # 可选：用本机 DSH 凭据库里的 AK/SK 真跑一次（无凭据则跳过）

`integration.test.mjs` 会真的打一次 `open.volcengineapi.com`：假 AK 会拿到
`InvalidAccessKey`——能拿到它，说明 endpoint、Action、Region、Version 与
签名头格式都已被网关接受，只差真实密钥。加 `--no-network` 可跳过联网段。

仓库中不含任何真实凭据：测试用的 AK 都是 `AKLTFAKE…` 之类的哑值，
`live-optional.mjs` 只在运行时从本机 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 读取。

- Coding Plan 接口只回百分比，没有绝对额度，面板按百分比展示。
- 团队版（Agent Plan Team / Coding Plan Team）目前按调用方席位查询，未做多席位汇总。
- 额度接口是控制面 API，与推理用量（token 计费）不是同一口径。
- **推理 API Key 不能用于额度查询**：实测用 `ARK_AGENT_PLAN_API_KEY` 直接请求
  `GetAFPUsage` 会返回 `400 InvalidAuthorization`，必须用 AccessKey 签名。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that adds a **sidebar panel for Volcengine Ark (火山方舟) plan quota**: remaining Agent Plan / Coding Plan quota, reset countdowns, usage stats and a monthly daily-usage heatmap.

Requires DSH 0.2.x (web or desktop).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:nnautilus/dsh-ark-quota

git clone https://github.com/nnautilus/dsh-ark-quota
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/dsh-ark-quota
```

A bar-chart icon appears in the left sidebar; click it to open the panel. You need to enter an AccessKey once (see below).

- **5-hour / weekly / monthly** quota windows: remaining AFP, used / total, used %, reset countdown
- **Usage stats**: plan tier, masked account, burn rate (%/hour), projected exhaustion
- **Monthly daily-usage heatmap** (Codex-style squares): current month calendar grid (weeks start Monday, color depth = usage, hover shows the day's value) plus a summary card with month total / today / daily average / active days / peak day / top model
- **Coding Plan** rows, only when actually subscribed
- Auto-refresh every 60 s (configurable) and a manual refresh button

Quota lives on the **control-plane OpenAPI**, not the inference endpoint:

```
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetAFPUsage&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetCodingPlanUsage&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
POST https://open.volcengineapi.com/?Action=GetUsageDetails&Region=cn-beijing&Version=2024-01-01
     body: { "QueryInterval": "Day", "Filter": { "Product": "agent-plan", "StartTime": "2026-10-01", "EndTime": "2026-10-27" } }

Authentication is Volcengine signature V4 (AccessKey ID + Secret). The Ark **inference** API key (`ARK_API_KEY`) does **not** work here — the gateway rejects it with `InvalidAuthorization`. Signing happens only on the Host side; secrets never reach the browser.

1. Create an AccessKey in the Volcengine console (avatar → *API Access Keys*), with permission to query Ark usage.
2. Open the panel and fill in AccessKey ID / Secret once — they are written to the DSH credential store under `VOLC_ACCESSKEY` / `VOLC_SECRETKEY`.
3. Optional `cordis.patch.yml` config:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accessKeyRef` | `VOLC_ACCESSKEY` | credential ref name for the AccessKey ID |
| `secretKeyRef` | `VOLC_SECRETKEY` | credential ref name for the AccessKey Secret |
| `region` | `cn-beijing` | control-plane region |
| `refreshSeconds` | `60` | cache TTL / refresh period (min 15) |
| `includeCodingPlan` | `true` | also query Coding Plan |
| `historySize` | `72` | in-memory samples (burn rate / projection) |
Credentials are normalized on the Host side (leading/trailing whitespace and a pair of wrapping quotes are stripped), so pasting values copied with quotes from the console still works.

The panel fetches data over a same-origin HTTP route registered by the Host:

```
GET /dsh-ark-quota/status[?force=1]  →  { ok: true, value: {...} }
```

Registered with `ctx.webServer.register` and guarded by `connection.requestRejection` (falling back to a same-origin + loopback check, fail-closed). Unauthenticated requests get 401, non-GET 405, unknown paths 404.

```bash
npm test           # signature/parsing + host integration + client render smoke
npm run test:live  # optional: run once with the local DSH credential store
```

The repo contains **no real credentials** — test keys are dummies like `AKLTFAKE…`, and `test/live-optional.mjs` only reads `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` at runtime (and skips when absent).

- Coding Plan only returns percentages, not absolute quota.
- Team plans are queried for the caller's seat; no multi-seat aggregation.
- The quota API is a control-plane API; it is not the same metric as billed tokens.
